method: Authored thematic regeneration using source durations, source-generator BPM and movement sections; not numerical G1 retargeting.
limitations: Kinematic targets only. No training, physics rollout, balance assessment, collision clearance certification, audio synchronization or hardware control.

clips.guideText:
0.00–0.92 s: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
0.92–29.08 s: Small side sways with a gentle fourth-beat knee accent; head tilts replace flowing arm gestures.
29.08–30.00 s: Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
clips.adaptation: Small side sways with a gentle fourth-beat knee accent; head tilts replace flowing arm gestures.

clips.guideText:
0.00–0.86 s: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
0.86–8.00 s: Small standing knee pulses and head accents; ease into a hold.
8.00–10.00 s: Hold a small standing head turn; this replaces the baby freeze.
10.00–20.00 s: Resume gentle knee pulses and head accents; ease into the second hold.
20.00–22.00 s: Hold the opposite head turn, standing on both feet; this replaces the chair freeze.
22.00–29.14 s: Small standing knee pulses and head accents; two standing holds replace floor freezes. No crossed legs, windmills or power moves.
29.14–30.00 s: Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
clips.adaptation: Small standing knee pulses and head accents; two standing holds replace floor freezes. No crossed legs, windmills or power moves.

clips.guideText:
0.00–1.00 s: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
1.00–29.00 s: Gentle coupled hip sway and bounded twists, with slow head turns replacing arm waves. No lifted-foot stepping.
29.00–30.00 s: Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
clips.adaptation: Gentle coupled hip sway and bounded twists, with slow head turns replacing arm waves. No lifted-foot stepping.

clips.guideText:
0.00–2.00 s: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
2.00–8.00 s: Gentle coupled knee bend and head dip; return to neutral.
8.00–16.00 s: Small head turn and tilt, both feet near neutral; return.
16.00–24.00 s: Modest coupled knee bend and nod; return.
24.00–32.00 s: Slow bounded head and hip turns; return.
32.00–38.00 s: Repeat the small coupled knee bend and head dip.
38.00–40.00 s: Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
clips.adaptation: Four small standing gestures replace horse, crane, tiger and dragon stances; no deep crouches, strikes or one-leg balance.

clips.guideText:
0.00–1.20 s: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
1.20–38.80 s: Small head turns and nods with deliberate holds replace angular arm poses and mechanical steps.
38.80–40.00 s: Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
clips.adaptation: Small head turns and nods with deliberate holds replace angular arm poses and mechanical steps.

clips.guideText:
0.00–0.67 s: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
0.67–8.00 s: Small knee pulses and sways.
8.00–9.50 s: One bounded positive head-yaw turn and return, not a full spin.
9.50–15.00 s: Resume small knee pulses and sways.
15.00–16.50 s: One bounded negative head-yaw turn and return, not a full spin.
16.50–24.33 s: Gentle knee pulses and sways; bounded head turns at the source spin windows replace full spins. No fast footwork or arm choreography.
24.33–25.00 s: Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
clips.adaptation: Gentle knee pulses and sways; bounded head turns at the source spin windows replace full spins. No fast footwork or arm choreography.
